actors.name: Founder of Tidepool
actors.private_context: The founder knows that some critical reviews were indeed taken down, as confirmed privately by the head of support. They have received emails from two journalists requesting comment. They are considering whether and how to respond publicly to the viral thread.

shared_context: A viral thread on social media accuses Tidepool of deleting critical reviews. The thread has two million views and includes screenshots that appear genuine. The founder has not yet posted any public response.

starting_events.description: The viral thread accusing Tidepool of deleting critical reviews is circulating online with two million views and screenshots that look genuine.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the founder of Tidepool posted a public response to the viral thread before 2026-09-10T15:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
